# GRC Engine - Continuous Automated Compliance & Audit Engine

> Continuous, code-first compliance automation, automated evidence collection, real-time audit readiness, and automated control verification for modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub, Kubernetes).

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Evidence Harvesting:** Continuous collection of infrastructure configurations, Git commit histories, CI/CD pipeline runs, and access policies.
- **Control Framework Mapping:** Out-of-the-box compliance controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.
- **Audit-Ready Dashboards:** Executive summary reports, granular gap analysis, policy deviation alerts, and live risk metrics.
- **Developer-First Integration:** Native CI/CD checks, PR scanners, and real-time posture feedback before merging to production.

## Key System Concepts
- `Evidence Collection Agent`: Lightweight background scanner reading cloud APIs & VCS state.
- `Policy Engine`: Evaluates rules as code against collected metadata.
- `Control Registry`: Maps raw infrastructure evidence into formal audit requirements.
- `Audit Vault`: Cryptographically signed evidence storage for auditor verification.
